title: Kenyan Lamb Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy lamb wrap inspired by Kenyan cuisine, served with a side of aromatic and light accompaniments.

ingredients.name: Kenyan spice mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most African markets or online

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together the Kenyan spice mix and 1 tablespoon of light olive oil.
Add the lamb strips to the spice mix and toss to coat.
Grill the lamb for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Meanwhile, brush the wraps with the remaining 1 tablespoon of light olive oil.
Warm the wraps on the grill or in a dry skillet for 30 seconds on each side.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a layer of Greek yogurt on each wrap, followed by a few slices of lamb, some sliced cucumber, diced tomato, and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
